text: The Aldermoor hoard, a cache of bronze age ornaments and coins uncovered during drainage work near Aldermoor Lane in March, is now on display at the Wexcombe Museum, officials confirmed Tuesday. The transfer follows a six-month conservation process and an agreement between the museum and the county heritage service. Curator Elin Marsh said the collection includes 214 items, among them bracelets, ingots and a decorated torque. “We’re pleased to keep the hoard together here in Wexcombe, where the public can finally see its full significance,” Marsh said. The exhibit opens to visitors on Saturday, with school tours scheduled for next week. County archaeologists said the find is the largest from the district in 30 years.
